period_note: Unaudited interim financial performance, sourced live from DSE's company page (fetched 2026-09-12, same page/method and same primary-source-unreachable situation as 2026_Q1.json -- see that file's period_note for the full account of why uttarabank-bd.com's own Q2/Half-Yearly filing could not be located: Cloudflare-gated HTML pages, 20+ filename guesses against /firstqreport/, /halfqreport/, /priceseninfo/ all 404, and zero Wayback captures of the site after 2025-12-14). Discrete Apr-Jun 2026 and cumulative Jan-Jun 2026 (Half Yearly) are both directly reported by DSE's table and are internally consistent with each other (both computed on the post-bonus 1,212,836,090-share base, per the reconciliation in 2026_Q1.json's period_note) -- Q1's OWN reported EPS (1.320, on the smaller pre-bonus 970,269,000-share base) is NOT simply additive with this quarter's discrete EPS (1.170) to reach the Half-Yearly cumulative (2.230); see 2026_Q1.json for the full share-count walkthrough, which reconciles to within 0.2%. DATA IS THIN, same caveats as Q1: EPS and market price only, no balance sheet, no NAV, no NOCFPS -- npl_pct, car_pct, total_assets, total_deposits, gross_loans, total_equity remain gaps. BASIS CAVEAT: DSE's table does not label Solo vs Consolidated; per 2026_Q1.json's cross-check against this bank's own Solo-basis 2025_Q2.json, this DSE table appears to run CONSOLIDATED, roughly 3% below the bank's own Solo figures -- not directly comparable to UTTARABANK's SOLO main series without that caveat in mind. Market price per share at period end (21.8) is identical for both the Q2 and Half-Yearly columns, as expected since both share the same 30-June-2026 period end.
